reviews.text:
We took the team class with Devin and Alex for our six month old Pomeranian.
They were patient and attentive with every participant, and we felt like we were getting individual attention the whole time. We highly recommend them as dog trainers and look forward to coming back for the next stages of our pup's development.

I highly recommend their services. Adam is the dog whisperer! They are very knowledgeable and their processes are incredibly simple (one-click invoice payment, automated appointment reminders by text message, etc.). I really enjoyed working with them and I feel much better equipped to handle my dog's future needs. Their services are super personalized (my dog ​​had his own training program updated after each session so I wouldn't forget the key concepts) and they are incredibly professional. 10/10!
I had the chance to meet Jesse and he gave me awesome advices on how to raise my new puppy! I recommend 100%

When we decided to get a dog, we knew that we had to set ourselves up for success. Getting a trainer was a must. After many hours of research, we landed on SWDT!

We booked private lessons with Adam. Within 2 hours of coming home, my puppy Marshall already met with our trainer! He helped us set solid foundations and even gave advice on how to best set up Marshall's crate, playpen, and overall puppy schedule. Adam was amazing, patient, and so helpful. He was a solid rock of support, which was especially needed during a puppy's first weeks after coming home!

We loved how the private lessons turned out so much that we decided to continue with the training and enrolled Marshall for puppy class and obedience 1 class. I can 100% say that they were all very worth it!

When raising a puppy, there's so much you can learn from online content. However, applying the theory in real life with your actual dog is, personally, priceless. The dog's feedback, subtle body movements and gestures, are all things you can easily miss. With a trainer, they can see such details and highlight it to you.

We've loved our time with SWDT and look forward to more of their classes in the future!
I worked with Adrian and he is a a very personable trainer who gives clear instructions.  He quickly developed a good working rapport with my dog.

We did 3 private classes and now we're in the outdoor group class. BIG improvement with our dog and he's getting better and better. And having fun while training.
Great, professional training. Definitely recommend it
Thanks Devin
Adam is a fantastic trainer. He is very skilled, insightful and easy to work with. We were very happy with the results of our group classes.

We did some private classes with Adam from Southwest Dog Training for our Shih Tzu puppy. We worked on impulse control, leash and place training. Adam’s a super friendly guy and skilled dog trainer, great at communication and follow up. Following Southwest’s structured approach has helped turn an unruly puppy into a great family pet. Would definitely recommend them to any new dog owner.

We took the Puppy Class with Adam followed by the Teen Course with Devin, and we honestly couldn’t be happier with the experience. The tools and techniques they taught us will be valuable for the rest of our dog’s life.

Before taking the classes, we had already watched countless YouTube videos and read tons of training advice online, but it simply doesn’t compare to learning directly from truly skilled trainers like Adam and Devin. The small details they focused on made a HUGE difference in our dog’s behavior and in our confidence as owners.

We can’t recommend Southwest Dog Training enough. If you’re considering it, just book the class — you won’t regret it!

The excellent trainer Devin O'Donnell and his teammate, trainer Adam Miller, are very skilled and competent in what they teach our 10-month-old female German Shepherd (Maly). She listens to us much better and follows instructions correctly. It's a great school for learning how to train our dog. Thank you both and to everyone who assists you.

Claude and Josette

We have been doing private training for our one year old dog Rooi, who is full of energy and a big lover of life. Devin has been extremely helpful with helping us work on boundaries and resource guarding. The written training plans after each session are really great and a wonderful resource to revisit. We were new to balanced training approach and Devin took the time to explain everything and offer many suggestions and alternatives. Rooi highly recommends Devin!

Highly highly recommend!! We've been working with Devin at Southwest Dog Training for a few months now and it has completely changed our relationship with our dog. When we came to Devin we were beyond stressed with a dog whom we loved but showed signs of aggression and resource guarding that we couldn't manage on our own. Devin came in with a ton of knowledge and helped us every step of the way. He developed a comprehensive plan that has really worked and we couldn't be more grateful.
Great experience, great teachers. Definitely recommend.

I’ve been training with Robert at Southwest Training, and he’s been incredibly helpful. My previous trainer moved away, so I was looking for someone with a similar style and approach. My reactive dog needed a few tune up sessions to reinforce what we’d already learned and to figure out what was (and wasn’t) working. We already had a good foundation, and Robert was enthusiastic about building on it and showing us new approaches, for both human and dog. I’d definitely recommend Southwest Training!

Southwest Dog Training has performed miracles with my 80lb  Belgian Malinois mix Shepherd 7 month old puppy and with me! Training can only work if both the dog and their owner are 'trained'.  Duke is already a lot of dog, at times overwhelming. However, with the skills I'm learning from Devin and from the professional walker/trainer, both Duke and I are happier and he's learning good behaviors and having fun at the same time!  So am I and I'm completely in love with my pup!  Thank you Devin for your patience and for travelling to the South Shore to help me help Duke be the best version of himself!  You guys are amazing.

My Romeo is very reactive around other dogs, anxious, and wary of humans as well, due to his difficult past. We contacted Southwest Dog Training, who were very understanding of the situation. Robert gave him the time he needed, providing the support he needed, and us too.
As the days went by, Romeo improved significantly: he felt more confident and secure during our walks. Today, he even has a new friend in the neighborhood, a little Belgian Malinois just like him! It was unexpected!
A huge thank you to Robert for his help. The adventure continues, and we are happy to see Romeo thriving day by day.
Great results!

Excellent trainers ! Robert helped us so much with our dog Apollo , he’s been in training for reactivity and Robert helped us so much to make him a much more confident and chill dog. Totally recommended !

We started our little guy Chester at SouthWest with their puppy classes. This was a great way for him to experience the outside world and gain some exposure to other people/puppies. Seeing as Chester is going to be a very large dog, we wanted to make sure he’s well trained, so Southwest put us in touch with one of their trainers, Rob.

We have been doing private sessions with Rob for a month now and he’s amazing! He’s extremely knowledgeable, understanding and dedicated - our puppy blues have faded away with his guidance and reassurance. The difference in Chester’s progress in just a short while has been incredible and we will definitely be keeping these sessions with Rob up!

We really recommend SouthWest and Rob - you won’t regret it!
Profesionnal and caring staff

To say that Devin is a great trainer doesn't do him justice. He is an amazing person who has truly become part of our family, and his team is fantastic and incredibly helpful throughout our journey.

We discovered Devin online through reviews, and since we had never owned a dog before, we weren't sure what to do. Additionally, our dog needed to be trained as a service dog, which made the situation even more overwhelming.

Before we picked up our puppy, Devin came to our home to help us prepare for her arrival. He assisted us in setting up everything we needed and provided drills for us to practice when she came home. Just two days after we brought her home, Devin began training her at the age of 7 weeks. Devin is more than just a trainer, he has truly become part of our family.

When my puppy got sick on Christmas Eve, Devin stayed up late helping us find a vet and kept in touch to ensure she was okay. When I had to go out of town for medical reasons, him and his wife, along with their dog Cash, took care of Minnie and trained her while she was with them.

Through both private and group classes, I’ve seen my puppy evolve from a baby into a service dog. Devin accommodated us in countless ways, from rescheduling sessions to arranging training in convenient locations. He was always available to answer any questions we had.

To anyone reading this review and undecided about whether to choose Devin and his team, let me be frank: it would be a mistake to look elsewhere.
Lilly and Adam were amazing! My dog Atlas and I did one personal session and a group session of 4 classes and they were super fun!

My puppy finished his 4 session training and it was a great experience for him and especially for me as this is my first dog. I definitely recommend them, the trainer sre all amazing and very helpful. Thank you guys, we will be signing up again in the future.
Really awesome dog school! We learned so much on the teen class, we're definitely going to take another obedience class with southwest dog training

I can’t recommend Southwest Dog Training enough. The trainers are not only incredibly knowledgeable, but also kind, patient, and truly passionate about what they do. I learned so much throughout the process, and the positive changes in my dog’s behavior—and our everyday life—have been remarkable. I’m so grateful for the support and guidance we received. It made a world of difference! I wish I could give 10 stars!!
This is a wonderful school! Small class sizes and a beautiful location. Devon and his team have helped forge an even deeper bond between Byron and I. I saw amazing progress from all the puppies.

Our puppy Bella recently finished her puppy obedience course with Devin and his fantastic team. She always got really excited and happy when she got there as it has consistently been a very positive experience for her.
Devin, Adam have been attentive and in addition with any help we needed for the regular class content, always checked in and asked if we were facing any specific/particular difficulties with Bella that week. They always had helpful, focused tips for our questions. We will most definitely be coming back for their other courses! We highly recommend them as your guides to shape you and your four-legged friends, to be the best companions for each other.

Super helpful classes! We always came out of the puppy classes, then the teen classes with new tips, and better understanding of our dog. Devin and Adam create a fun environment with clear instructions and doable homework. They are also great at problem-solving for specific situations.

Completed dog teenage classes at Southwest Dog Training in a group class and was very impressed with the training that Devon and Adam provided.   The steps were simple to follow and with small class sizes it made the experience more personal and they were able and willing to help the dogs that needed assistance.   These classes really made a difference in my dogs behaviour and set him on a path that we can work on in the future.   Highly recommend!

Devin and his team are the most incredible group of trainers. They have such love and patience for animals. I learnt so much from them about how to foster good habits in my puppy and avoid bad habits, all based on a relationship of trust and positivity rather than negative reinforcement. I cannot recommend them highly enough and look forward to continuing to work with them in the future.

We had minor problems with our puppies (mostly going outside due to anxiety) so we called Devin for some help. As soon as he came he knew exactly in what direction we should go with them to do better, he definitely have the magic touch with dogs✨

Thank you Elise and Adam for the fantastic classes, and answering all our questions. They are passionate about what they do and very thorough in answering questions. Most importantly they're very observant and help adjust to each pup. I also appreciate the detailed homework assignments each week.

Edit: I continued with Southwest into the teen class (my pup started becoming reactive). The class was led by Devin, his "gentle parenting" style and advice did not help my pup, instead things got increasingly worse. Then it simply felt like Devin wanted to push for individual sessions and money rather than help address my concerns. In the end, I had to go find another training school and undo the behaviours my puppy had learned from this teen class.

Devin and Adam are simply amazing! So patient with both us and our dog! In 4 weeks we saw such an improvement in our puppy and we’ll definitely keep going! If you want a kind, stress and judgement-free environment to train your doggie, this is it!
Great experience with Devin and Adam. Kind, knowledgeable and great with Bailey (our puppy).

Devon and the team are excellent at their craft. Me and my puppy/teen looked forward to class each week. To this day we continue with the training methods and it is making our relationship much more enjoyable.

I couldn’t be happier with Southwest Dog Training!

For my two puppies, I contacted Devin and his team, and chose to do a combination of in-home training and their group puppy classes. The experience incredible! Devin made the sessions fun and engaging, not just for my dogs but for me too. I learned so much, and was able to train my puppies with basic obedience and some advanced obedience topics as well.

My puppies have made amazing progress, and im already planning to enroll them in the teenage dog classes. I highly recommend Southwest Dog Training to anyone looking for professional, effective, and enjoyable dog training. You won’t be disappointed!

Devin and team were great! We started with Puppy classes for our goldendoodle, Winston who started at 8 weeks old. We couldnt believe the progress he made in the last 4 weeks! Its also a plus to me and my partner that SWDT is in english. As we wanted to establish commands in english with our puppy.  Devin and his team also curated a super easy homework for us to follow every week at home. It really works! We look forward to doing Teen class next.

PS. Devin also has an awesome instagram page where he shares tips and tricks.

We had a great experience with Southwest Dog Training. We did the perfect puppy class, and everywhere I bring my puppy (vet, groomers..) they comment on how well behaved he is.  I would definitely recommend this class to all new dog owners!

This was my first dog training course.  I definitely recommend if u have puppy or an older dog to register.  The techniques used to teach your dog was well organized. plus every class we was giving homework to practice at home. This was more than what I expected.

Previously had always trained our dogs privately. This time we brought our pup Emma to Southwest Dog Training for “puppy class” to socialize her as well as teach her/us basic commands. Ratio of trainer to pup was good. (6 dogs to 2 trainers) Devin and Andy were great and very likeable. We
Enjoyed the vibe and pace as well as the way we were instructed. We had 4 weeks of classes and homework was sent after each class for us to practice. Our pup came out of this experience better behaved and gained a lot of confidence. I would highly recommend.
Thanks Devin and Adam for a job well done.
The training, attention, and personalization from Southwest Dog Training was top notch. …
We did the puppy class and was very good!

Great experience for us and our puppy Olly! The team took time with each puppy to give more personalized tips given each of their personalities. We also received homework/clear instructions each week to work with them at home. Very enjoyable, definitely recommend!

Southwest dog traing is great! Devin and Adam are very knowledgeable and with a very positive approach to dog training, we learned so much about training our dog in a way that made us comfortable. Our puppy made so much progress over the 4 …
Great curriculum and instruction. We took the teen class and our dog has been better behaved ever since. We look forward to future classes.
My pup and I truly enjoyed the classes, the instructors were knowledgeable and patient. It was a pleasure and I would go back!
